title: Strict-diagram normalization of integral open product comparisons
statement:
Fix primes $p\ne\ell$, an integer $a\geq1$, $k=\overline{\mathbf F_{p^a}}$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, its valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $A_{E,m}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^m$ for $m\geq1$. Use a six-functor datum [def-sf-datum] with its specified canonical exchange and projection transformations [def-exchange-projection, def-sf-pf]. All schemes below are separated finite-type $k$-schemes and all morphisms are separated of finite type. Integral pullbacks and tensors are completed; field operations use rationalization and common finite stages. Take $\Lambda=\mathcal O_E$, $I=(\varpi_E)$, and let $f=aj:X\to B$, $g=bk:Y\to B$ be compactifications with open $j:X\hookrightarrow\bar X$, $k:Y\hookrightarrow\bar Y$ and proper $a,b$. Put $T=X\times_BY$, $\bar T=\bar X\times_B\bar Y$, $u=j\times_Bk$, $c:\bar T\to B$. Let $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\mathcal O_E)$, $L\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ and, for a third factor, $M\in D^b_{ctf}(W,\mathcal O_E)$ with compactification $h=dl$ of $W\to B$. Use their actual strict finite reduction diagrams, whose $m$th components are derived reductions modulo $I^m$, and the completed operation comparisons of [def-exchange-projection, fix-lem-exchanges]. In the derived categories of strict diagrams of constant $\mathcal O_E$-module sheaves, write $J_v$ for termwise extension by zero along an open $v$ and $G_v$ for termwise restriction. The sheaf open base-change and projection maps with their quotient-ring actions induce diagram morphisms
$$e^\bullet_{j,k}:(J_jK_\bullet)\boxtimes^L_{A_{E,\bullet}}(J_kL_\bullet)\xrightarrow{\sim}J_u(K_\bullet\boxtimes^L_{A_{E,\bullet}}L_\bullet),$$
where tensor is the derived pointwise tensor of diagrams over the quotient-ring diagram $m\mapsto A_{E,m}$ and $\boxtimes$ includes projection pullbacks. These maps restrict to the identity and satisfy the swapped-factor and three-factor associativity equalities in the derived diagram category. Under the proper/open diagram comparisons $\Gamma_Q$ of [lem-sp-proper-open-tower-comparison], the diagram expansion of the canonical exchange/PF compactification composite equals the proper composite followed by $R_c^{\mathcal T}(e^\bullet_{j,k})$, where $R_c^{\mathcal T}$ is total derived termwise direct image. Applying functorial $R\lim$ and the completed operation comparisons yields a natural completed isomorphism
$$e^c_{j,k}:(j_!K)\boxtimes(k_!L)\xrightarrow{\sim}u_!(K\boxtimes L)$$
with the same signed symmetry and associativity equalities, and the completed compactification identity
$$\lambda_{aj,bk}(K,L)=Rc_*(e^c_{j,k})\circ\lambda_{a,b}(j_!K,k_!L).$$
Here $\lambda$ is the explicit exchange/projection composite defined in [lem-sf-product-compactification-identity], now evaluated with completed operations. The finite reductions are bounded constructible and have bounded etale-origin witnesses; only the actual reduction diagrams carry transitions, and no transitions between the witnesses are assumed. Rationalization of these morphisms, and scalar extension from a common finite coefficient field to $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, yield the same open comparison identities and compactification identity in those stages. No faithfulness of finite reduction on integral derived morphisms is asserted.

proof.text: Use [lem-sf-product-system-uniform-realization-domain] for $R,I$, all product compactifications and the three integral inputs. It supplies completeness and finite quotients, Noetherianity and properness, uniform constructible cohomological/Tor bounds and compatible origins for the actual normalized systems. Hence every expression used below meets the realization domain, without choosing transitions between separate witnesses.

Apply [lem-sf-semilinear-open-external-coherence] with $C_n=A_{E,n}$ to the actual reductions. Its ordered open base-change/tensor word is $e^\bullet_{j,k}$; it is invertible, restricts to the identity, and satisfies the swapped-factor and triple-product equations in the whole system category. Termwise scalar restriction gives exactly the asserted maps on constant-$R$ towers; the tensor remains the tensor over $(A_{E,n})_n$.

Apply [lem-sf-semilinear-product-compactification-calculation] with $C_n=A_{E,n}$ to the same compactifications; its Noetherian and quasi-compactness hypotheses were checked in step 1. Its pasted exchange identity and open-adjunction tensor equation give, in the whole system category, $\lambda^{\mathscr S}_{aj,bk}(K_\bullet,L_\bullet)=S_c(e^\bullet_{j,k})\lambda^{\mathscr S}_{a,b}(J_jK_\bullet,J_kL_\bullet)$, where the composition map uses the system $\Gamma_Q$, the $J_k\dashv P_k$ adjunct of $\lambda_Q^{-1}$. Apply termwise scalar restriction to constant-$R$ towers, which only applies a functor to this equality. By the last paragraph of [lem-sf-semilinear-proper-open-mate-pasting] (with $B=R$), the restriction of the system $\Gamma_Q$ is the normalized constant-tower mate of [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus]. The same node with the constant system $C_n=R$ shows that this mate is the open adjunct of the inverse of the clopen open-restriction isomorphism $\lambda_Q$. That is the definition of $\Gamma_Q$ in [lem-sp-proper-open-tower-comparison]. Hence the restricted equality is the required diagram compactification identity, with $R^{\mathcal T}_c(e^\bullet_{j,k})$, before evaluation.

The domain of step 1 and the equations of steps 2–3 satisfy [lem-sf-product-normalization-realization-transport]. Apply its total-limit transport to obtain the natural completed $e^c$, its identity restriction, signed symmetry, associativity and $\lambda_{aj,bk}=Rc_*(e^c)\lambda_{a,b}$. The transport identifies the ordered generators, including exactly the $\Gamma_Q$ specified in the statement. Its coefficient-transport clause gives the same maps and equations after rationalization and common-stage scalar extension, with independence of enlargement. No equality has been inferred from equality of finite evaluations.
